[ASSISTANT] Assistant suggested using dark glass bottles for packaging infused oils and provided tips for ensuring compliance with FDA regulations and good manufacturing practices.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips on pricing herbal teas and infused oils, including competitor analysis, cost-based pricing, value-based pricing, and pricing strategies like tiered pricing and bundle deals.
